Faen.description: Attuned to the wilds and whispers between worlds, the Faen are beings of quiet magic and ancient memory. They carry grace in their blood and secrets in their silence, forever shaped by the echoes of what was.

racial_mechanic.name: Echoes of the Past
racial_mechanic.description: Faen experience flashes of ancient memory at key moments, providing warnings, insights, or sudden recollections that can unlock hidden paths, reveal dangers early, or auto-succeed on Lore or Magic checks.

Faen.flavor: Rare and ethereal, Faen are often viewed with awe or unease in civilized lands. Their presence stirs something primal in the hearts of others.

Kindred.description: Adaptable and ambitious, the Kindred are the most widespread of the mortal peoples — driven by will, shaped by their own choices, and burdened by no ancient destiny but the one they forge themselves.

racial_mechanic.name: Surge of Will
racial_mechanic.description: Kindred build Willpower by succeeding at difficult skill checks or surviving major challenges. Once enough Willpower is gathered, they can unleash a Surge: instantly succeeding on a future vital check, or turning a failed check into a partial success. In moments of greatest need, the Kindred refuse to fall.

perks: Broader access to skills and professions
Kindred.flavor: Seen as the common heart of many cities and kingdoms, Kindred often hold positions of power, invention, and leadership — or rebellion.

Emberkin.description: Forged in ash and ambition, the Emberkin are descendants of those who stole forbidden power from the gods. Their souls burn with volatile sparks of ancient fire, tempering them into beings of brilliance, danger, and unrelenting drive.

racial_mechanic.name: Burn the Limits
racial_mechanic.description: Once per major encounter, Emberkin can Overburn: automatically succeeding at a powerful action or acting twice in one moment. Afterward, they suffer backlash, weakening their next action or leaving them vulnerable.

perks: Magic manifests as hearthfire, bonfire, or wildfire — unpredictable but powerful
Emberkin.flavor: Feared, revered, or exploited, Emberkin walk a path between outcast and icon. Wherever ambition burns brightest, Emberkin are never far behind.
